login.title: Sign in
login.ssoDesc: Sign in with your Single Sign-On account to continue.
login.inviteOnlyDetail: If you don't have an account yet, ask the administrator for an invite link.

invite.alreadySignedInBody: Signed in as <bold>{{email}}</bold>. If this invite link was meant for someone else, sign out first and reopen it.
invite.welcomeBlurb: Welcome to <bold>Riposte Social</bold>. To complete your invite we need to save the code on this device for the duration of sign-in.
invite.trustedDeviceTitle: Are you on a trusted device?
invite.trustedDeviceBody: If this is a shared or public computer (library, kiosk, friend's phone), please open the invite link on your own device instead. The code will stay in the URL bar of this browser; once you navigate away or close the tab, no trace remains.
invite.cookieNoticeBody: Riposte Social uses cookies that are strictly necessary for authentication, security (CSRF protection), and for invited users saving your invite state across sign-in. We do not use tracking, analytics, or advertising cookies.
invite.confirmFailed: Could not confirm the invite. Please try again.
invite.acceptGeneric: Sign in to join the conversation.
invite.declinedTitle: Open this link on your own device
invite.declinedBody: No invite state has been saved on this browser. To accept, forward the link from your email to a private device and open it there.
invite.invalidBody: This invite is no longer valid. It may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Ask the person who invited you to issue a new one.

splash.title: You've been invited
splash.forRecipient: This invite is for <bold>{{email}}</bold>. Sign in to accept and start participating.
splash.generic: Sign in to accept your invite and join the conversation.
